tips: Pokémon Center: no schedule, but about a third of drops land on Wednesdays around midday ET (often with a queue).
Target: restocks mostly Friday mornings around 8 AM local; Monday and Wednesday are backups.
Walmart: shelves Tue–Fri 7–10 AM; online MSRP drops are reported Wednesday evenings.
Best Buy: no fixed pattern online, the bot reads its buy button about every half hour.
Release day: big-store pages often flip from Coming Soon to Add to Cart at midnight–6 AM ET.
Sell fast on new releases: preorder prices usually slide into launch (Delta Reign ETB −15% and its Pokémon Center ETB −21% in the month before release).

faq.a: A fan-run Pokémon restock and deal tracker. It watches stores for Elite Trainer Boxes, booster boxes and more, tells you what you would make flipping them, and also posts shoe, electronics, money and travel deals.

Yes. Every restock alert, the Good and Hot electronics deals, every other deal channel, the stock checker, points and giveaways are free. 💎 Premium adds more monitors: every graded deal, a price-drop tracker, flip-only and hot-tech feeds with pings, and a weekly report. See #upgrade-to-premium.

faq.q: Does the bot buy anything for me?
faq.a: No. It never logs in to a store, buys, or holds your payment details. It tells you what is in stock and you check out yourself.
The profit after fees, shipping and tax clears the bar and you still make money if the resale price drops 10%. ⚠️ RISKY, 🟡 THIN, 🔻 PASS and 👀 WATCH are explained in #how-it-works.

faq.q: Why are Target, Walmart and Best Buy not checked automatically?
faq.a: They block automated checks, and we do not work around that. We list them with links, post learned restock windows and a Target and Walmart run sheet in #stock-check, and read Best Buy through its own API where possible.
Open #pick-your-roles and choose your pings. Nothing pings you unless you opt in. `/notify` sends a DM for one product or keyword, and `/dealwatch` does the same for deals.

faq.q: How accurate are the profit numbers?
faq.a: They are estimates from recent sold prices with eBay fees, shipping, packing, a return reserve and 7% tax taken out. Anything marked "rough" has less data, so check eBay sold listings before you buy.

Electronics deals are graded 🔥 Hot, 👍 Good or 🙂 Fair from the discount, the dollars saved, best-price wording and the lowest price we have tracked for that item. Accessories and refurbished items must clear a higher bar.

faq.q: Where do the deals come from?
faq.a: Public deal sites and blogs that allow automated reading. Each post links straight to the store item when the page shows it, or to that store's search for the item. Always confirm price and stock at checkout.

faq.q: How do points and ranks work?
faq.a: Check in daily with `/checkin`, chat, share in-store sightings and log buys and sales. Six rank roles unlock as your points grow. `/leaderboard` shows the top members.
Your stock checks, ledger and watches are only visible to you. A saved ZIP is kept for 90 days. We never ask for passwords or payment details in Discord.

faq.q: Is the sports betting section advice?
faq.a: No. It has calculators and guides only, with no picks and no promises. 21+ and only where legal. If gambling stops being fun, call or text 1-800-GAMBLER.
Open a ticket in #help-desk or use `/support`. A private channel is created for you and the support team.
A fan-run project, not affiliated with The Pokémon Company, Nintendo or any store.

traps.title: Reprints crash prices
traps.text: Sets that get reprinted fall 30 to 50 percent. Sell within a few weeks, not months.

traps.title: Keep it sealed
traps.text: Resale values are for factory-sealed product. Opened or damaged boxes sell for far less.

traps.title: Check the seller
traps.text: Only buy from the store itself or a seller you trust. Marketplace sellers raise prices on hot items.

traps.title: Never pay first on trades
traps.text: Use platform payment protection. Be wary of gift cards, "friends and family" payments and anyone rushing you.

traps.title: Mind the limits
traps.text: Stores limit purchases per guest. Do not try to get around a limit with multiple accounts.

traps.title: Keep records
traps.text: Profit is taxable income. `/ledger csv` exports every buy and sale for your records. This is not tax advice.

traps.title: Do not chase
traps.text: If the number stops working at the shelf price, pass. The next restock is coming.
